//: Plan budgets for the AI usage meter. The collector upserts these into mission.ai_plans for MC_USER_ID on every run. Edit here, not in the DB. Claude plans are split by ACCOUNT (the Claude config dir a log sits in; see scripts/usage/collect-logs.mjs and docs/ai-usage.md): claude-max = main (ejaffejax@gmail.com, ~/.claude), claude-4lot = ejaffe@4lot.org (~/.claude-4lot and ~/.claude-reserve). Claude 4lot carries an estimated weekly cap (0.0625 x main, config/ai-usage-capacity.json). For Claude main Anthropic publishes no token cap, so limit_value is null ('no cap known', shown neutral grey with burn in tokens); its % and forecast come from Claude Code's own /usage meter, recorded hourly (claude-usage --record on ubuntu-dev; docs/ai-usage.md), or a newer manual reading. Set limit_value (tokens/week, estimate) only if Eric picks a budget.

plans.name: Claude Max (main)
plans.notes: Main account: Claude Code logs under ~/.claude on ubuntu-dev (herdr fleet + tmux sessions), box, mac-mini. No published cap: its % comes from the hourly /usage meter (runs/claude-usage.jsonl) or a newer manual reading.

plans.name: Claude Team (4lot)
plans.notes: ejaffe@4lot.org (Team Standard seat): logs under ~/.claude-4lot (claude-4lot wrapper, herdr pane 'fourlot') and ~/.claude-reserve. Weekly cap ESTIMATE 325M logged tokens = 0.0625 x Claude main's ~5.2B/week (config/ai-usage-capacity.json); the hourly /usage meter for the 4lot login (runs/claude-usage-4lot.jsonl) or a newer manual reading overrides it.

plans.name: ChatGPT / Codex
plans.notes: Codex CLI logs its own rate limits (5h primary, weekly secondary); the page uses the weekly one.
